Are the leadership qualities necessary to be a good manager or in building a startup?

Well here is the thing, there is such a thing as both a leader and a manager. A good manager can take a system that is already laid out for them and they can "manage it". They typically are not the ones that design those systems but they are excellent at being able to maintain them to the expectations placed on them. Leaders are the individuals that typically learn to think outside of a box and they create the systems that a manager will manage. A leader sees a problem and is able to find or create a solution to the problem or situation. So in answering, I feel it is more necessary to be a good leader if you are building the startup but you will need great managers to ensure consistency of product and services.
